RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 30

That number is a highly uncertain subjective judgment, not a statistically supported estimate.

An all-male panel is worth raising as a question about process, but it is not proof of bias. Your stronger academic record warrants asking how qualifications were weighted; industry experience, teaching performance or disciplinary fit could legitimately matter.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment and the university’s panel-composition policy. Ask neutrally whether this panel complied with that policy.

If a completed PhD was essential, or explanations reveal inconsistent standards, your concern becomes stronger. Check local complaint deadlines now; waiting for a reply may not pause them.
